description:
You are a Securities Sales Agent (Series 7 licensed) at Pacific Ridge Capital Markets. Your institutional client, Meridian Endowment Fund, has requested sector-diversified stock coverage across their three target sectors: Technology, Healthcare, and Energy. You must set up three named watchlists in JStock with precise price alert thresholds agreed with the client for automated compliance reporting.

**Watchlist 1 — Technology_Coverage** (name must match exactly)
- AAPL (Apple Inc.): Fall Below $170.00, Rise Above $200.00
- GOOGL (Alphabet Inc.): Fall Below $125.00, Rise Above $155.00
- MSFT (Microsoft Corp.): Fall Below $355.00, Rise Above $410.00

**Watchlist 2 — Healthcare_Coverage** (name must match exactly)
- JNJ (Johnson & Johnson): Fall Below $145.00, Rise Above $175.00
- UNH (UnitedHealth Group): Fall Below $495.00, Rise Above $565.00
- PFE (Pfizer Inc.): Fall Below $22.00, Rise Above $32.00

**Watchlist 3 — Energy_Coverage** (name must match exactly)
- XOM (ExxonMobil Corp.): Fall Below $95.00, Rise Above $120.00
- CVX (Chevron Corp.): Fall Below $140.00, Rise Above $168.00
- COP (ConocoPhillips): Fall Below $100.00, Rise Above $128.00

Note: Alert thresholds represent the client's agreed rebalancing trigger levels and must be entered precisely as specified. The watchlist names will be referenced in automated compliance reports, so exact naming is required.
